g.title: dbml
g.text: Crow’s Foot: circle = 0; bar = 1; fork = N. Solid = identifying; dashed = non-identifying. PK / FK / UQn = key labels; (!) = NOT NULL.

g.title: profiles
g.text: Exactly 1 Profile per User; create atomically.

g.title: student_verifications
g.text: Partial UQ: at most 1 Approved per Profile.
Reviewer required on approval; may be NULL before review.
